$comment: FROZEN designed surface (covenant) for pragma v2. Each PR emits only the entries it has built and asserts emitted ⊆ covenant (see kernel/spec/surfaceConformance.ts). PR7 is the surface-completion PR: it emits ALL tools (emitted == covenant); PR9 extended this to 39 tools (added config_set, 38→39) and extends mcpSurface with the non-tool surfaces — resources (the pragma:{+uri} template), prompts (the native prompts/* capability), and instructions (the handshake orientation); PR10 extended it to 40 tools (added the colophon self-verb + its tool, 39→40); AV-228 B1 blesses `ontology_lookup` (the ratified by-name read name) and keeps `ontology_show` as a deprecated alias, 40→41; AV-228 B3 RETIRES the per-field setters `config_tier`/`config_channel`/`config_detail` in favour of `config_set <key> <value>`, 41→38; AV-228 B8 unifies ALL `create application` include-flags on the `--with-X` convention (`--ssr`/`--router`/`--forms`/`--relay` → `--with-ssr`/`--with-router`/`--with-forms`/`--with-relay`; tool count unchanged). L-PR6 (PRA-107 ruling, PROJECT FROM CONFIG) records the WIRE IDENTITY rule as mcpSurface.serverInfo: serverInfo PROJECTS from the distribution — name is the declared distribution name, version the package version — so a fork's server introduces itself under its own name (surface.test.ts pins the covenant text, identity.test.ts pins the wire from a fork's config); the resource template pragma:{+uri}, the pragma:<uri> URIs it mints, and the pragma/box / pragma/instanceCount _meta keys stay FROZEN protocol identity every distribution serves unchanged — clients persist resource URIs, and the measured half-derivation (template renamed, minting sites literal) made all 653 of a fork's resources unreadable; tool count unchanged. L-OPEN-9 removes the non-compliant commands — reads the declared grammar can express become declared content, the rest is removed: `tier_lookup` becomes the tier story's compiled lookup (args `<name>` → `<name...>`, the variadic every pack lookup emits); `block_list` becomes the block story's compiled list (`--all-tiers` retired with the hand-written tier-chain/channel filtering — it lists ALL blocks, experimental included, for everyone, until filtering returns in declared form); `token add-config` is REMOVED rather than made declared — it writes a `tokens.config.mjs` starter file, and the content grammar deliberately has no mutation verb, 38→37. L-OPEN-10 strips the `v2` framing from the `bins.pragma` description string (`pragma v2 CLI and MCP server host (stdio)` -> `pragma CLI and MCP server host (stdio)`) — the tool is the tool, not a successor to something; the FILENAME and the chronological records above keep their `v2` because they are history, not a claim about the product. Prompt NAMES are graph data, guarded by the prompt tests, not frozen here. The fixed sections mirror FIXED_SURFACE in kernel/spec/emitSurface.ts verbatim. L-CIS (Create-Is-Summon ruling, 2026-08-21) makes the `create` surface a PROJECTION of the summon generator tree — `pragma create <path…>` ≡ `summon <path…>` over the three declared bindings, the contract is executed rather than written down (crossCli.subprocess.test.ts runs both CLIs over the same argv and compares what they emit): the CLI mounts tree segments as subcommands (`create component react|svelte|lit`, `create application react`), the `--framework` flag dies loudly naming the new form, and every schema DERIVES from the generators' PromptDefinitions — `create_component` keeps a framework enum argument derived from the tree segments (now required, no default, mirroring the tree), gains the svelte-only `--use-ts-stories`, and `component`'s per-framework prompt truth replaces the shared mirror; `create_application` sheds the B8 `--with-X` aliases for the generator's own `ssr`/`router`/`forms`/`relay`; `run-install` follows the generators' default (install on); the PRA-14 compiled-binary gate and its availability-caveat text die — the compiled binary generates all three, proven byte-equal to source runs; non-TTY mutations without complete input REFUSE in both products; tool count unchanged; the fixed sections are untouched by this clause. L-CIS-2 (round-15 correction, 2026-08-23) makes the create noun's flag lists the REGISTERED spellings and retires the ssr/router pair: a mounted noun's flags derive through the projection's buildOptionInfo — a default-true confirm registers ONLY its `--no-<kebab>` form — so the covenant names tokens the CLI parses (`--no-with-styles`, `--no-run-install`, …) instead of kebab-cased param names it rejects (kernel-registered verbs keep the kebab convention: B9's negation is additive there); the `args` are typed tokens under the same rule — the registered kebab positional the usage line prints (`[component-path]`, `[app-path]`), never the camelCase param name; and `application/react` drops its `ssr`/`router` prompts — SSR and the router are always on (the scaffold has no SPA arm), the pair's only explicit spelling was the negation the generator's own guard rejected (an unfollowable refusal), so `create_application` loses the two args, the wizard the two dead questions, and the flag list shrinks to `--no-forms`/`--relay`/`--no-run-install`; tool count unchanged; the fixed sections are untouched by this clause. The CLI-standards grammar pass settles one spelling per job: `config` gains `get <key>` (one resolved value, bare on stdout, shell-substitutable) and `unset <key>` — clearing a field is a COMMAND, not a magic value, so `set` now refuses the strings that used to double as clear-markers and names `unset` instead; `ontology show` is REMOVED, leaving `lookup` as the single by-name read; `version` joins as the command form of `--version`, withheld from MCP because the version already rides `info` and the handshake's serverInfo; tools 37→38 (`config_get`, `config_unset` added, `ontology_show` removed). The fixed globalFlags section gains `--quiet` (success and progress muted, error rendering untouched) and scopes the `--verbose` doc to `sources update`, the one command that reads it. `mcp serve` stops being a hidden self-verb the bin alone knew about and becomes an ordinary noun/verb pair: it emits, completes, and answers `--help` like every other command, so the `mcp` noun's covenant entry is now REACHED by the emitter rather than merely declared (the hand-written `note` goes with it — the reason a verb is withheld from MCP lives on the verb spec, and the covenant records the emitted shape). The bin keeps a narrow short-circuit for the exact `pragma mcp serve` invocation so the server's stdio stays JSON-RPC-only; every other `mcp …` argv walks the ordinary tree. The --intl port (i18n behind an opt-in flag in application/react) adds `--with-intl` to `create application`; flag list only, tool count unchanged. The concept read story (ds:Concept — long-form design-system documentation ingested from Coda, canonical/design-system#64) adds the `concept` noun: a declared list (--type/--search) and a SPARQL lookup serving the Markdown body at `standard` disclosure, 38→40 tools (concept_list, concept_lookup). The implementation read story gives the ds-implementations pack a noun: `implementation` lists the ds:ImplementationObject edges (which library implements which block, on which platform, in which source file) with --platform/--library/--search, and `implementation libraries` lists the ds:ImplementationLibrary nodes through the same list machinery (as `standard categories` does). LIST-ONLY by construction — a ds:ImplementationObject carries no name literal, so there is nothing a lookup could disclose that the list row does not already hold and no name a user would ever type; 40→42 tools (implementation_list, implementation_libraries).

budgets.$comment: help/complete/warmStoreVerb are designed aspirations; the ENFORCED ceilings (budgets.test.ts) are 130ms help / 100ms complete / 500ms warmStoreVerb, each derived from measurement on the build hardware and recorded in BUDGETS.md. Designed-aspiration vs enforced-measured. warmStoreVerb joined this list when the embedded pack became the distribution's real graph rather than a sample, which puts the reference box's projected p95 over the designed 300ms; BUDGETS.md carries the arithmetic.
